name: APIVerveBase64EncoderDecoder
summary: Base64 Encoder/Decoder encodes plain text into Base64 and decodes encoded strings back to readable characters.
description:
Base64 Encoder/Decoder encodes plain text into Base64 and decodes encoded strings back to readable characters. Submit any string with an encode or decode action to receive the converted output, the original input, and character length.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the Base64 Encoder/Decoder from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
